description: Content tabs (one webview per server). Deliberately minimal: session commands (store once / refresh / clear — the refresh token is never readable), distribution/policy info and the update notice, relaunch, and opening http(s) URLs in the system browser for OAuth. No shell, no filesystem, no HTTP plugin. The JS updater (updater:default) is granted at runtime only when this build may install updates itself (distribution::grant_updater).
